Key constraints: we want to move quickly but make sure the offer aligns with level expectations.

- If you strongly object to moving forward, reply-all and mark OBJECTION in the subject.

Scoring rubric (high level):
- Technical (0-5)
- System design (0-5)
- Collaboration/communication (0-5)
- Hiring bar (Yes/No)

Scorecard (edit): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GkQ-example-scorecard
Attachments: candidate_resume_aisha_khan.pdf (pdf), panel_scorecard_Aisha_Khan.xlsx (xlsx)

Notes to highlight from interview:
- Strong backend foundations; clear ownership examples.
- System design was solid but asked for clarifying constraints more than we'd expect at L4.
- Communication was concise and collaborative.

I'll consolidate and propose a next step after I have everyone's inputs. Thanks —
